title: Hook modules find lint/ through one hooks-home lookup, and their fail-open paths refuse
why: Lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, 16:00 CST Nov 8, from round-3 or later reviews; queued follow-up the lane starts when its wait ends. Started 15:51 CST, branch hooks-home-lookups off #2301. Four modules find lint/ from their own folder; the closure walk stops at lint/; reread_check Stop, pre-read and post-compact modes allow when ph is None; page checks allow on an unreadable layout; partial-module load checks; question_form import failure fails open; a use_hooks_home mutant.
